description: Chen 2009 NED 239:1010 Table 1: beta=7.26e-3, Lambda=1.68e-3 s, alpha=-1.4e-4 dk/k/degC, 3.3 MW, 2.5 MPa, 212/650 degC. description: openfoam-basic-lib's only ndarray-linalg use is the dev-dep in tests/matrix_bench.rs (pure-Rust SquareMatrix vs LAPACK). The dev-dep is already target-gated to linux/macos/windows, so it is absent on Android (target_os=android). Added #![cfg(not(target_os=android))] to matrix_bench.rs so the test no longer references the absent ndarray_linalg on Android. Lib src does not use ndarray-linalg, so openfoam-basic-lib's library already builds headless.
title: Gate ndarray-linalg matrix benchmark off Android (openfoam-basic-lib)
